1/ D.A. Davidson says $MU to $3,000. Here's what you'd have to believe: 🧵

$MU closed at $1,029 on Friday. $3,000 is +192% from here, on a stock already up 266% in 2026.

• ~$3.45T market cap vs ~$1.18T today
• 18.6x Davidson's FY27 EPS of $161
• Today it trades ~6x consensus FY27 EPS (~$174)

At a 10-15x "peak-cycle" multiple, you'd need $200-300 of EPS. FY26 EPS was $75.52.

Bull checklist ✅

• Micron sees 2027-28 supply "much tighter" than 2026, no line of sight to balance
• 75%+ of 2027 output already committed
• 26 take-or-pay deals, ~$150B contracted
• Most 2027 HBM sold at higher prices
• $68.3B net cash, buybacks ramp from Dec 9

Bear checklist ❌

• It's a multiple bet: Davidson's $161 EPS is below the ~$174 consensus
• Capex race: Micron ~$25B in 1H FY27, Samsung just posted a record ₩107.4T Q3 profit
• Slower memory content growth per server
• Taiwan (50-60% of chips): a union authorized a strike

The earnings aren't the debate. Micron guided $61.5B revenue and ~86% gross margin for this quarter.

The debate is whether the market will ever pay a market multiple for memory.
